task: Find the biggest files in a folder
summary: Lists the ten largest files under a folder, biggest first, to see what is eating the disk.
command: Get-ChildItem FOLDER -Recurse -File | Sort-Object Length -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 FullName, Length

task: Find a file by its name
summary: Looks through a folder and everything under it for names containing a word.

task: List the files in a folder
summary: Shows what is in the folder you are in, or in the one you name.

task: Show hidden files
summary: Lists a folder including the hidden and system items a plain listing leaves out.

task: Delete a file
summary: Removes one file for good.
danger: The file does not go to the Recycle Bin.

task: Delete a folder and everything in it
summary: Removes a folder with all of its contents, without asking.
danger: Everything inside is gone for good.

task: Make a new folder
summary: Creates an empty folder where you are.

task: Go up one folder
summary: Moves to the folder that contains the one you are in.

task: Return to the folder I was just in
summary: Jumps to wherever you were before the last move, and back again.

task: Show which folder I am in
summary: Prints the full path of the current folder.

task: Find text inside files
summary: Searches the contents of files for a word or pattern and shows the matching lines.

task: See what is running
summary: Lists every running program with its id, memory and processor time.

task: Stop a program that will not close
summary: Ends a program by name when it has frozen and its window ignores you.
danger: Unsaved work in that program is lost.

task: See what is using a port
summary: Names the process holding a port, for when a server says the address is already in use.

task: Check whether a port is open on another machine
summary: Tries a connection to a host and port and says whether it got through.

task: Show my IP address
summary: Lists the addresses this machine has on each network.

task: Unzip an archive
summary: Unpacks a zip file into a folder.

task: Zip a folder
summary: Packs a folder into one zip file.

task: See an environment variable
summary: Prints the value of one variable, PATH for instance.

task: See the commands I typed before
summary: Lists what you ran in this session, oldest first.

task: Clear the screen
summary: Empties the window and puts the prompt at the top.

task: Open a shell as administrator
summary: Starts a second PowerShell with elevated rights, after the Windows prompt.

task: Copy a file
summary: Makes a second copy somewhere else.

task: Rename a file
summary: Gives a file a new name where it is.

task: Show which user I am signed in as
summary: Prints the account this shell runs under.

task: List the files in a folder
summary: Shows what is in the folder you are in.

task: Delete a folder and everything in it
summary: Removes a folder with all of its contents, without asking.
danger: Everything inside is gone for good.

task: Find where a program is installed
summary: Prints the full path of the exe a command name runs.

task: Stop a program that will not close
summary: Ends a program by its exe name.
danger: Unsaved work in that program is lost.

task: See what is using a port
summary: Finds the line for a port, whose last column is the process id.

task: Clear the screen
summary: Empties the window.

task: Find the biggest files in a folder
summary: Lists the ten largest files under a folder, biggest first.
command: find FOLDER -type f -exec du -h {} + | sort -rh | head -n 10

task: Find text inside files
summary: Searches the contents of every file under a folder and shows the matching lines.

task: Keep only the lines of output that mention something
summary: Pipes any command through a filter so only matching lines are shown.

task: Delete a folder and everything in it
summary: Removes a folder with all of its contents, without asking.
danger: Everything inside is gone for good.

task: Stop a running program
summary: Asks a process to end, by its id.

task: See what is using a port
summary: Names the process holding a port.

task: Unzip an archive
summary: Unpacks a zip file into a folder.

task: Show hidden files
summary: Lists a folder including the names that start with a dot.

task: Go up one folder
summary: Moves to the folder that contains this one.

task: Show which folder I am in
summary: Prints the full path of the current folder.

task: Read a long file a page at a time
summary: Opens a file in a pager: space for the next page, q to leave.

task: Undo the last commit but keep the changes
summary: Takes the newest commit back and leaves its changes staged.
danger: Rewrites history: do not do it to a commit you have pushed.

task: Throw away my changes to a file
summary: Puts a file back to how the last commit had it.
danger: The edits are gone for good.

task: See the commit history
summary: Lists the last twenty commits, one line each.

task: See what has changed
summary: Shows the files that are modified, staged or new.

task: Shrink a long Claude conversation
summary: Typed inside Claude Code: summarises the conversation so far to free up context.

task: Pick up a Claude conversation where it stopped
summary: Opens a list of earlier sessions for this folder.

task: Install a program
summary: Downloads and installs an application by name.
